content:
GRAND GROUP CORPORATION is a professional chemical enterprise located in Ningbo, Zhejiang, China, with its office based at 13F, Pacific Plaza, No. 555 Jingjia Road. Situated in one of China’s most dynamic coastal cities and close to the world-class Port of Ningbo, the company benefits from excellent logistics, enabling efficient domestic distribution and competitive global export services.

As a comprehensive chemical supplier, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION focuses on the research, development, production, and trade of a wide range of chemical products. Its portfolio typically covers industrial chemicals, specialty chemicals, and tailored formulations serving sectors such as coatings, plastics, rubber, textiles, detergents, construction materials, water treatment, and related manufacturing industries. By integrating sourcing, quality inspection, and technical support, the company aims to offer customers stable supply, consistent quality, and professional service.

The company emphasizes strict quality management and responsible handling of chemicals. It works with qualified production bases and testing facilities, and adheres to relevant Chinese and international standards, prioritizing product safety, environmental compliance, and reliable documentation. With an experienced team familiar with both domestic and overseas markets, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION is committed to building long-term partnerships, providing flexible solutions, and responding quickly to customer needs.

Leveraging Ningbo’s strong industrial foundation and port advantages, GRAND GROUP CORPORATION positions itself as a dependable partner for global buyers seeking competitive, quality-assured chemical products from China.
